description: Asks Meta to create a test lead for a list's form. The test lead goes to the list's real destinations; on another account it may email the customer, so ask the human before setting acknowledge_customer_impact. Without it on another account the API answers 400 customer_impact_not_acknowledged.

account_id.description: Admin keys only: the LeadSync account (user id, integer or digit string) to act on; overrides LEADSYNC_ACCOUNT

acknowledge_customer_impact.description: Set true only after the human confirmed the customer may be emailed. Required when acting on another account

list_id.description: LeadSync list id from list_leads or attach_form

name: send_test_lead
